# Fast-Drone-250 / EGO-Planner project overlay

Upstream project: ZJU-FAST-Lab/Fast-Drone-250.

This directory contains **only the project-specific modified/new planner files** recovered from the supplied workspace. It is intentionally not a full copy of the upstream repository.

## Usage

1. Obtain a compatible Fast-Drone-250 checkout separately.
2. Review `docs/EGO_PLANNER_MODIFICATIONS.md`.
3. Compare each file in `overlay/` with the corresponding upstream path.
4. Apply or copy the changes into your upstream checkout.
5. Build and validate in simulation before real flight.

The exact upstream commit used by the original workspace was not preserved in the supplied archive, so this overlay should not be treated as a guaranteed clean patch against an arbitrary newer commit.
